summary: Implemented the rich.progress file-reading feature (uncommitted). Changes: rich/progress.py gains private _ProgressReader and _ReaderContext, module-level open and wrap_file (with Literal overloads), and Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file methods. tests/test_progress.py gains 22 tests before the script-entry block. docs/source/progress.rst gets the "Reading from a file" and "Reading from a file-like object" subsections. CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet referencing PR 1759. Not verified: I did not run tests, black, or mypy, per instructions; all checks were by reading. Deviation: the reader also defines mode and name properties delegating to the handle, because typing.IO declares them abstract on Python 3.6. Module-level open types its mode parameter as Any internally to avoid overload-matching errors. Suppressions used: readline override; readinto no-untyped-def and override; handle.readinto attr-defined.
